newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Airlines cuts fares by 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Airlines cuts fares by 50 pct.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Monday the company launched a system-wide fare sale, cutting prices by at least 50 percent from its regular three-day advance purchase fares.
Travelers must purchase tickets by August 15 for travel between August 11 and December 16, and reservations must be made at least three days in advance.
Examples of fares include Chicago to Dallas for $64, down from $128, and Kansas City to San Francisco for $79, down from $159.
